estabCombatHint.en: Accuracy: chance each tower shot hits · Armor: share of every invader hit the walls ignore. Both rise with tower level.
estabCombatHint.tl: Katumpakan: tsansang tumama ang bawat tira ng tore · Baluti: bahagi ng bawat tama ng kalaban na hindi tumatagos sa pader. Parehong tumataas sa antas ng tore.

wallpaperDesc.en: Show the realm artwork behind the island. Turn off for a plain dark backdrop (lighter on slow devices).
wallpaperDesc.tl: Ipakita ang larawan ng kaharian sa likod ng isla. Patayin para sa simpleng madilim na likuran (mas magaan sa mabagal na device).

liveFocusHint.en: Click to jump to this battle
liveFocusHint.tl: I-click para puntahan ang labanang ito

autoBuyMaterialsNote.en: Auto-Buy is always active: missing upgrade materials are automatically purchased when supplies are sufficient.
autoBuyMaterialsNote.tl: Laging aktibo ang Auto-Buy: awtomatikong binibili ang mga kulang na materyales kapag sapat ang barya at gamit.

resetRealmConfirm.en: This will permanently erase EVERYTHING: your whole Realm (buildings, minions, resources, upgrades, runes, achievements, days, waves), every save, and all settings and your music library. The game restarts from the title screen. This cannot be undone. Continue?
resetRealmConfirm.tl: Buburahin nang tuluyan ang LAHAT: ang buong Realm (buildings, minions, resources, upgrades, runes, achievements, days, waves), bawat save, at lahat ng settings at music library. Magsisimula ulit ang laro mula sa title screen. Hindi na ito maibabalik. Ituloy?

importFailed.en: Failed to read the save file. Please select a valid IsoChronicle JSON export.
importFailed.tl: Hindi mabasa ang save file. Siguraduhing valid na IsoChronicle JSON file ito.

tenantsHint.en: Minions spawn for free and look like the Champion; they are the units you see on the map.
tenantsHint.tl: Libreng lumilitaw ang mga alagad at kamukha sila ng Kampeon; sila ang nakikita mo sa mapa.

enhanceDismiss.tl: Itago hanggang sa susunod na level

introContinueHint.en: Click or press Space to continue
introContinueHint.tl: I-click o pindutin ang Space para magpatuloy

introFullscreenError.en: Fullscreen is unavailable in this browser.
introFullscreenError.tl: Hindi suportado ang fullscreen sa browser na ito.

hubNothingReady.en: Nothing affordable yet. Gather or trade at the Market to unlock the next upgrade.
hubNothingReady.tl: Wala pang kayang bilhin. Mag-ipon o makipagkalakalan sa Pamilihan para sa susunod na upgrade.

hubGuideMinionsBody.en: Evolve the Slime and Treant, summon Generals, and assign work.
hubGuideMinionsBody.tl: I-evolve ang Slime at Treant, ipatawag ang mga Heneral, at magtalaga ng trabaho.

hubGuideSkillsBody.en: Spend points earned from waves on team-wide bonuses. Free to reset.
hubGuideSkillsBody.tl: Gastusin ang puntos mula sa mga alon sa bonus ng buong koponan. Libreng i-reset.

hubGuideResearchBody.en: Long-term upgrades for the Slime, Treant, citadel, establishments and minions.
hubGuideResearchBody.tl: Pangmatagalang upgrade para sa Slime, Treant, kuta, pasilidad at alagad.

hubGuideCastleBody.en: Walls, shield, beacon, and every establishment's tower and repairs.
hubGuideCastleBody.tl: Pader, kalasag, beacon, at tore at pagkukumpuni ng bawat pasilidad.

hubGuideForgeBody.tl: Gamit sa labanan at bala ng tore.

hubGuideMarketBody.en: Trade coins for missing materials, or sell extras.
hubGuideMarketBody.tl: Ipagpalit ang barya sa kulang na materyales, o ibenta ang sobra.

estabResearchMoved.en: Establishment and minion research now lives in Citadel Command, together with every other upgrade.
estabResearchMoved.tl: Nasa Citadel Command na ang pagsasaliksik ng pasilidad at alagad, kasama ng lahat ng iba pang upgrade.

gfxStruggling.en: Running at {fps} FPS: try a lower preset for smoother play.
gfxStruggling.tl: {fps} FPS lang ang takbo: subukan ang mas mababang preset para mas smooth.

gfxShadowsHint.en: Ground shadows under units and buildings.
gfxShadowsHint.tl: Anino sa ilalim ng mga yunit at gusali.

gfxGlowHint.en: Additive glow halos and sparks on skill casts and hits.
gfxGlowHint.tl: Kumikinang na halo at kislap sa mga skill at tama.

musicPlayerDesc.en: Play your own YouTube music while you play. Save as many playlists, albums, tracks or videos as you like and switch between them in the player. Your list is saved on this device on its own, apart from your realm progress: saving, exporting, importing or resetting the game never changes it (use the playlist export to move it).
musicPlayerDesc.tl: Patugtugin ang sarili mong musika mula sa YouTube habang naglalaro. Mag-save ng kahit ilang playlist, album, kanta o video at magpalipat-lipat sa player. Hiwalay na naka-save ang listahan sa device na ito, hindi kasama ng progress ng realm: hindi ito nagbabago kapag nag-save, nag-export, nag-import o nag-reset ng laro (gamitin ang export ng playlist para ilipat ito).

musicPlayerInvalid.en: That isn't a YouTube link we can play.
musicPlayerInvalid.tl: Hindi iyan link ng YouTube na kayang patugtugin.

musicPlayerNote.en: Needs an internet connection. The game's own music goes quiet while the player is open; sound effects keep playing.
musicPlayerNote.tl: Kailangan ng internet. Tumatahimik ang sariling musika ng laro habang bukas ang player; tuloy pa rin ang sound effects.

musicPlayerOffline.en: You're offline. The music player needs an internet connection.
musicPlayerOffline.tl: Offline ka. Kailangan ng internet ng music player.

musicPlayerEmpty.en: No music set yet. Add a YouTube link in Settings.
musicPlayerEmpty.tl: Wala pang nakatakdang musika. Maglagay ng link ng YouTube sa Settings.

musicPlayerShuffle.tl: I-shuffle ang mga naka-save na link

musicPlayerFull.en: The list is full. Remove one first.
musicPlayerFull.tl: Puno na ang listahan. Magtanggal muna ng isa.

musicPlayerAutoPlay.en: Auto-play: starts on its own and moves to the next saved link
musicPlayerAutoPlay.tl: Auto-play: kusang tumutugtog at lumilipat sa susunod na naka-save na link

musicPlayerLoop.en: Auto-loop: repeats the list (or this link when auto-play is off)
musicPlayerLoop.tl: Auto-loop: inuulit ang listahan (o ang link na ito kapag naka-off ang auto-play)

musicPlayerFileDesc.en: Download your list to edit it in Excel / Sheets (.csv) or a docs app (.txt), then upload it back. Any line with a YouTube link is added; the rest of the line becomes its name.
musicPlayerFileDesc.tl: I-download ang listahan para i-edit sa Excel / Sheets (.csv) o sa docs app (.txt), tapos i-upload ulit. Idinadagdag ang bawat linya na may link ng YouTube; ang natitirang text sa linya ang magiging pangalan.

musicPlayerImportNone.en: No new YouTube links found in that file.
musicPlayerImportNone.tl: Walang bagong link ng YouTube sa file na iyon.

loadingStepCharacters.tl: Tinatawag ang mga alagad at manlulupig…

loadingTip1.en: Every establishment, the Crystal Spire included, has a General and two minions.
loadingTip1.tl: Bawat pasilidad, kasama ang Crystal Spire, ay may isang General at dalawang alagad.

loadingTip2.en: Expeditions through the rifts stir human vengeance: the next wave grows.
loadingTip2.tl: Ang mga ekspedisyon sa lagusan ay nagpapagalit sa mga tao: lumalaki ang susunod na alon.

loadingTip3.en: The Ent repairs what the invaders break once every General answers its call.
loadingTip3.tl: Inaayos ng Ent ang sinira ng mga manlulupig kapag sumagot na ang bawat General.

loadingTip4.en: Move an establishment between waves to reshape your defences.
loadingTip4.tl: Ilipat ang pasilidad sa pagitan ng mga alon para baguhin ang depensa.

realmPickHint.en: Pick the realm to fight in anytime. A later realm brings tougher, bigger and faster waves; an earlier one eases them. The realm changes after the current wave if one is on.
realmPickHint.tl: Pumili ng kaharian na paglalabanan kahit kailan. Mas mabagsik, mas marami at mas mabilis ang alon sa mas huling kaharian; mas magaan sa mas nauna. Magbabago ang lakas ng alon sa susunod na alon kung may laban ngayon.

introMapPreview.en: Every new realm rolls its own curved coastline.
introMapPreview.tl: Bawat bagong kaharian ay may sariling kurbadong baybayin.

introMapLocked.en: This realm is already founded; its map stays.
introMapLocked.tl: Naitayo na ang kahariang ito; mananatili ang mapa nito.

seaHint.en: Waves, brawls, fires and deaths poison the sea. Past the first mark the Sea Folk rise to fight demons and humans alike; past the second the Leviathan joins. A tribute cleanses the water and keeps them off your demons for a few waves.
seaHint.tl: Nilalason ng mga alon, away, sunog at kamatayan ang dagat. Lampas sa unang marka, umaahon ang Sea Folk para labanan ang demonyo at tao; lampas sa ikalawa, sumasali ang Leviathan. Nililinis ng alay ang tubig at hindi nila gagalawin ang iyong mga demonyo sa ilang alon.

broodHint.en: Waves, brawls and fires shake the ground. Past the first mark Arachnids and Scorpions burst out to fight everyone, Sea Folk included; past the second the Ancient Caterpillar joins. It burrows under the land between battles, churning grass into sand that settles back after a few days. A tribute calms it and keeps the brood off your demons for a few waves.
broodHint.tl: Niyayanig ng mga alon, away at sunog ang lupa. Lampas sa unang marka, lumalabas ang mga Gagamba at Alakdan para labanan ang lahat, kasama ang Sea Folk; lampas sa ikalawa, sumasali ang Sinaunang Higad. Humuhukay ito sa ilalim ng lupa sa pagitan ng labanan, ginagawang buhangin ang damo na bumabalik sa lupa makalipas ang ilang araw. Pinapakalma ito ng alay at hindi gagalawin ng brood ang iyong mga demonyo sa ilang alon.

focusSkillsHint.en: F / G / H cast. ← / → next General, drag or Esc to stop following.
focusSkillsHint.tl: F / G / H para gumamit. ← / → susunod na Heneral, i-drag o Esc para tumigil sa pagsunod.

genNone.en: No Generals on the field yet. Each establishment's General appears once it stands.
genNone.tl: Wala pang Heneral sa larangan. Lilitaw ang Heneral ng bawat establisyemento kapag nakatayo na ito.

genPickFirst.en: Tick one or more Generals first.
genPickFirst.tl: Pumili muna ng isa o higit pang Heneral.

genBrawlHint.en: Immediately starts a brawl between two random living Generals when no other battle is active. The winner absorbs the loser's power.
genBrawlHint.tl: Agad na magsisimula ng rambulan ang dalawang random na buhay na Heneral kapag walang ibang laban. Makukuha ng nanalo ang lakas ng natalo.

genBrawlWave.en: A brawl can start only when no other battle is active.
genBrawlWave.tl: Makapagsisimula lamang ang rambulan kapag walang ibang aktibong laban.

genBrawlMissing.en: Both Generals must be alive on the field.
genBrawlMissing.tl: Kailangang buhay sa larangan ang dalawang Heneral.

genBrawlRage.en: Both need full rage. Rage fills when they fight, take hits and clash.
genBrawlRage.tl: Kailangang puno ang galit ng dalawa. Napupuno ito kapag lumalaban, natatamaan at nagbabanggaan.

genFortifyHint.en: Spend the ticked Generals' + power: it becomes extra max HP for their own establishment, and their + resets.
genFortifyHint.tl: Gastusin ang + na lakas ng mga napiling Heneral: magiging dagdag na max HP ito ng sarili nilang establisyemento, at babalik sa wala ang kanilang +.

genFortifyNone.en: No + power to spend (or the establishment isn't built yet).
genFortifyNone.tl: Walang + na lakas na magagastos (o hindi pa tapos ang establisyemento).

genSellPlusHint.en: A +10 General cannot brawl. Sell all ten + levels to the castle for ten random tier-one runes.
genSellPlusHint.tl: Hindi na maaaring rumambol ang +10 na Heneral. Ipagbili sa kuta ang sampung + level kapalit ng sampung random na tier-one na runa.

genSellPlusNone.en: Only +10 Generals can sell their power as runes.
genSellPlusNone.tl: Mga +10 na Heneral lamang ang maaaring magbenta ng lakas bilang runa.

genSellPlusDone.en: The castle forged {count} runes from the sold power.
genSellPlusDone.tl: Humubog ang kuta ng {count} runa mula sa ipinagbilíng lakas.

genTapHint.en: Tap portraits to pick Generals, or use a quick pick above.
genTapHint.tl: I-tap ang mga larawan para pumili ng Heneral, o gamitin ang mabilisang pagpili sa itaas.

genAirHint.en: Flyers & long-range: can hit the Kirov
genAirHint.tl: Lumilipad at malayuan: tatama sa Kirov

legacyEmpty.en: No fallen Demon Lords yet. When a castle falls, its run is engraved here.
legacyEmpty.tl: Wala pang nasawing Demon Lord. Kapag bumagsak ang kuta, iuukit dito ang takbo nito.

legacyPermadeathHint.en: Permadeath ({difficulty}): if the castle falls the run ends for good and is engraved here. Waves never end; the game saves itself after every wave.
legacyPermadeathHint.tl: Permadeath ({difficulty}): kapag bumagsak ang kuta, tapos na ang takbo at iuukit ito rito. Walang katapusan ang mga alon; kusang nase-save ang laro pagkatapos ng bawat alon.

gameOverBody.en: {lord}'s reign is over. The realm and its save are gone; your legacy is engraved in the Hall.
gameOverBody.tl: Tapos na ang paghahari ni {lord}. Wala na ang kaharian at ang save nito; nakaukit na ang iyong pamana sa Bulwagan.

introLordName.en: Your Demon Lord name (shown in the Hall of Legacy)
introLordName.tl: Pangalan ng iyong Demon Lord (makikita sa Bulwagan ng Pamana)

settingsBiomeHint.en: The island's realm: its look, water life and music. Waves keep their strength in every biome.
settingsBiomeHint.tl: Ang kaharian ng isla: itsura, buhay sa tubig at musika. Pareho ang lakas ng mga alon sa bawat biome.

titleNoSaveHint.en: No saved realm on this device. Start a new realm or upload a save file.
titleNoSaveHint.tl: Walang naka-save na kaharian sa device na ito. Magsimula ng bago o mag-upload ng save file.

titleUploadFailed.en: Could not load that save file. It may be damaged, not an IsoChronicle save, or from a run that has already fallen.
titleUploadFailed.tl: Hindi ma-load ang save file. Maaaring sira ito, hindi save ng IsoChronicle, o galing sa takbong bumagsak na.

profileUploadHint.en: Pick a picture (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to 8 MB). It is cropped to a square.
profileUploadHint.tl: Pumili ng larawan (PNG, JPG, WebP o GIF, hanggang 8 MB). Gagawin itong parisukat.

profileImageError.en: That picture could not be used. Try a PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF under 8 MB.
profileImageError.tl: Hindi magamit ang larawang iyon. Subukan ang PNG, JPG, WebP o GIF na mas mababa sa 8 MB.

profileCardHint.en: Your name and picture appear beside every run you lose in the Hall of Legacy.
profileCardHint.tl: Lalabas ang pangalan at larawan mo sa tabi ng bawat takbong natalo ka sa Bulwagan ng Pamana.

legacyLocalNote.en: The Hall of Legacy is kept on this device for now. A Steam leaderboard will come with the Steam release.
legacyLocalNote.tl: Sa device na ito muna nakatago ang Bulwagan ng Pamana. Darating ang Steam leaderboard kasabay ng Steam release.

settingsCursorHint.en: Animated pixel cursor: ember claw, aether glow on buttons, sky-laser reticle over the map in battle.
settingsCursorHint.tl: Gumagalaw na pixel cursor: kuko na may baga, liwanag ng aether sa mga button, reticle ng sky-laser sa mapa habang may laban.

settingsDifficultyHint.en: Changing the difficulty of a running realm costs resources (more to make it easier). The price grows with the wave.
settingsDifficultyHint.tl: May bayad ang pagpalit ng hirap ng tumatakbong kaharian (mas mahal kapag pinadali). Tumataas ang presyo kasabay ng alon.
